items.claim: Reuse cached FormData in parseBody instead of re-serializing it. A handler or middleware awaits `c.req.formData()` and then calls `c.req.parseBody()` on a multipart/form-data request.
items.consequence: parseBody now rejects with `TypeError: Failed to parse body as FormData.` because arrayBuffer() re-serializes the cached FormData with a new boundary that no longer matches the Content-Type header; the base returned the fields.
items.proposed_fix: In `parseFormData` in `src/utils/body.ts`, when the request is a HonoRequest with `bodyCache.formData` set, await and use that value. Otherwise read `arrayBuffer()`, call `bufferToFormData` and cache the result, as the form case in `src/validator/validator.ts` does.
